title: Pristina protest against formation of the Community of Serb-majority Municipalities (ZSO/CSM)
reason: A retrospective report explicitly says only a few dozen citizens gathered at this Jan31 protest, below the project’s 50-person threshold. The event targeted Kosovo policy, but the documented count is under 50.
notes: KoSSev’s contemporaneous report describes the action against the formation of the ZSO at noon in front of the Kosovo Government but gives no crowd estimate; it explicitly attributes the start/location details to Koha. Kosovo Online’s later report at lines 67–74 gives the below-50 estimate and separates a Feb15 student march announcement. No access was attempted for any additional Koha URL beyond the recorded exact outcomes.
open_questions: Could another independent account materially conflict with the retrospective “few dozen” estimate?

title: North Mitrovica protest against Vučić and Serbian List
reason: The report describes several dozen people demanding action from the authorities in Belgrade over Serbia–Kosovo negotiations and Kosovo’s arrests/security forces. Its stated target is Serbia’s government, not Kosovo’s state or policy, and the reported count is below 50.
notes: Kept separate from the Štrpce protest on the same date. RTCG/BBC body lines 290 and 298–299 distinguish the gatherings, their sites, different organizers and different targets.
